id: \rHello! I'm a Move Tutor!
en: \rHello!  I'm a Move Tutor!
it: \rCiao!  Sono un'Insegnamosse!

id: \rI can teach a special and powerful move to your Pokémon.
en: \rI can teach a special and powerful move to your Pokémon.
it: \rPosso insegnare una mossa speciale e potente ai tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rWhich special move would you like me to teach?
en: \rWhich special move would you like me to teach?
it: \rQuale mossa speciale vuoi che insegni?

id: \rWould you like me to teach another Pokémon a special move?
en: \rWould you like me to teach another Pokémon a special move?
it: \rVuoi che insegni una mossa speciale a un altro Pokémon?

id: \rCome back any time!
en: \rCome back any time!
it: \rTorna quando vuoi!

id: \bUh...\nOh, yes, I'm the Move Deleter.
en: \bUh...\nOh, yes, I'm the Move Deleter.
it: \bEhm...\nAh, sì, sono il Cancellamosse.

id: \bI can make Pokémon forget their moves.
en: \bI can make Pokémon forget their moves.
it: \bPosso far dimenticare le mosse ai Pokémon.

id: \bWould you like me to do that?
en: \bWould you like me to do that?
it: \bVuoi che lo faccia?

id: \bWhich Pokémon should forget a move?
en: \bWhich Pokémon should forget a move?
it: \bQuale Pokémon deve dimenticare una mossa?

id: \bCome again if there are moves that need to be forgotten.
en: \bCome again if there are moves that need to be forgotten.
it: \bTorna pure se ci sono mosse da far dimenticare.

id: \bWhat? No Egg should know any moves.
en: \bWhat?  No Egg should know any moves.
it: \bCosa?  Un Uovo non dovrebbe conoscere nessuna mossa.

id: \bWhat? I can't make Shadow Pokémon forget a move.
en: \bWhat?  I can't make Shadow Pokémon forget a move.
it: \bCosa?  Non posso far dimenticare una mossa a un Pokémon Ombra.

id: \b\v[3] seems to know only one move...
en: \b\v[3] seems to know only one move...
it: \bSembra che \v[3] conosca una sola mossa...

id: \bWhich move should be forgotten?
en: \bWhich move should be forgotten?
it: \bQuale mossa deve essere dimenticata?

id: \bHm! \v[3]'s \v[4]? That move should be forgotten?
en: \bHm!  \v[3]'s \v[4]?  That move should be forgotten?
it: \bMh!  \v[4] di \v[3]?  Vuoi che dimentichi quella mossa?

id: \bIt worked to perfection!
en: \bIt worked to perfection!
it: \bHa funzionato alla perfezione!

id: \b\v[3] has forgotten \v[4] completely.
en: \b\v[3] has forgotten \v[4] completely.
it: \b\v[3] ha dimenticato completamente \v[4].

id: \bI'm the Pokémon Move Maniac.
en: \bI'm the Pokémon Move Maniac.
it: \bSono il Maniaco delle Mosse Pokémon.

id: \bI know every single move that Pokemon learn growing up.
en: \bI know every single move that Pokemon learn growing up.
it: \bConosco ogni singola mossa che i Pokémon imparano crescendo.

id: \bI'm also a collector of Heart Scales.
en: \bI'm also a collector of Heart Scales.
it: \bColleziono anche Squame Cuore.

id: \bIf you bring me one, I'll teach a move to one of your Pokémon.
en: \bIf you bring me one, I'll teach a move to one of your Pokémon.
it: \bSe me ne porti una, insegnerò una mossa a uno dei tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bOh! That's it! That's an honest to goodness Heart Scale!
en: \bOh! That's it! That's an honest to goodness Heart Scale!
it: \bOh! Eccola! È una Squama Cuore autentica al cento per cento!

id: \bLet me guess, you want me to teach one of your Pokémon a move?
en: \bLet me guess, you want me to teach one of your Pokémon a move?
it: \bFammi indovinare, vuoi che insegni una mossa a uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \bWhich Pokémon needs tutoring?
en: \bWhich Pokémon needs tutoring?
it: \bQuale Pokémon ha bisogno di lezioni?

id: \bIf your Pokémon need to learn a move, come back with a Heart Scale.
en: \bIf your Pokémon need to learn a move, come back with a Heart Scale.
it: \bSe i tuoi Pokémon devono imparare una mossa, torna con una Squama Cuore.

id: \bHunh? There isn't a single move that I can teach an egg.
en: \bHunh? There isn't a single move that I can teach an egg.
it: \bEh? Non c'è nemmeno una mossa che possa insegnare a un uovo.

id: \bNo way, I don't want to go near a Shadow Pokémon..
en: \bNo way, I don't want to go near a Shadow Pokémon..
it: \bNeanche per sogno, non voglio avvicinarmi a un Pokémon Ombra...

id: \bSorry...
en: \bSorry...
it: \bMi dispiace...

id: \bIt doesn't appear as if I have any move I can teach to your \v[3].
en: \bIt doesn't appear as if I have any move I can teach to your \v[3].
it: \bA quanto pare non ho nessuna mossa da insegnare al tuo \v[3].

id: \bWhich move should I teach to your \v[3]?
en: \bWhich move should I teach to your \v[3]?
it: \bQuale mossa devo insegnare al tuo \v[3]?

id: \PN handed over one Heart Scale in exchange.
en: \PN handed over one Heart Scale in exchange.
it: \PN ha consegnato una Squama Cuore in cambio.

id: \bHello, hello!\nI am the official Name Rater!
en: \bHello, hello!\nI am the official Name Rater!
it: \bSalve, salve!\nSono il Giudice dei Nomi ufficiale!

id: \bWant me to rate the nicknames of your Pokémon?
en: \bWant me to rate the nicknames of your Pokémon?
it: \bVuoi che valuti i soprannomi dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \bWhich Pokémon's nickname should I critique?
en: \bWhich Pokémon's nickname should I critique?
it: \bDi quale Pokémon devo giudicare il soprannome?

id: \bI see.\nDo come visit again.
en: \bI see.\nDo come visit again.
it: \bCapisco.\nTorna pure a trovarmi.

id: \bNow, now... That is merely an Egg!
en: \bNow, now... That is merely an Egg!
it: \bSu, su... Quello è soltanto un Uovo!

id: \bI wouldn't dare critique a Shadow Pokémon's name!
en: \bI wouldn't dare critique a Shadow Pokémon's name!
it: \bNon oserei mai giudicare il nome di un Pokémon Ombra!

id: \bHmmm... \v[3] it is!
en: \bHmmm...  \v[3] it is!
it: \bMmmh...  \v[3], dunque!

id: \bThis is a magnificent nickname! It is impeccably beyond reproach!
en: \bThis is a magnificent nickname!  It is impeccably beyond reproach!
it: \bÈ un soprannome magnifico!  È assolutamente impeccabile!

id: \bYou'll do well to cherish your \v[3] now and beyond.
en: \bYou'll do well to cherish your \v[3] now and beyond.
it: \bFaresti bene ad avere cura del tuo \v[3], ora e per sempre.

id: \b\v[3], is it?\nThat is a decent nickname!
en: \b\v[3], is it?\nThat is a decent nickname!
it: \b\v[3], eh?\nÈ un soprannome discreto!

id: \bBut, would you like me to give it a nicer name?
en: \bBut, would you like me to give it a nicer name?
it: \bMa vorresti che gli dessi un nome più bello?

id: \bHow about it?
en: \bHow about it?
it: \bChe ne dici?

id: \bAh, good. Then, what shall the new nickname be?
en: \bAh, good.  Then, what shall the new nickname be?
it: \bAh, bene.  Allora, quale sarà il nuovo soprannome?

id: \bDone! From now on, this Pokémon shall be known as \v[3]!
en: \bDone!  From now on, this Pokémon shall be known as \v[3]!
it: \bFatto!  D'ora in poi, questo Pokémon si chiamerà \v[3]!

id: \bIt looks no different from before, and yet, this is vastly superior!
en: \bIt looks no different from before, and yet, this is vastly superior!
it: \bSembra uguale a prima, eppure è di gran lunga superiore!

id: \bHow fortunate for you!
en: \bHow fortunate for you!
it: \bChe fortuna per te!

en: \bIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!
